new-horizons:metamagic.name: Metamagic
new-horizons:metamagic.description: Single-target spell overkill spills to the nearest enemy. Own area, chain and global friendly damage is reduced; resisted single-target debuffs can retry once. Optional perks unravel or reconstitute magic.

basic.description: Arcane Overflow transfers 30% of primary single-target spell overkill to the nearest other enemy. Own area, chain and global spells deal 70% friendly damage. Resisted single-target debuffs have a 30% chance to retry once with normal resistance.

effect.description: Arcane Overflow transfers 30% of primary single-target spell overkill to the nearest other enemy. Own area, chain and global spells deal 70% friendly damage. Resisted single-target debuffs have a 30% chance to retry once with normal resistance.

basic.details: Overflow is damage only and cannot recurse. Each secondary keeps normal magical defenses; immunity is not a resisted debuff. No extra Mana, Hero Action or manual secondary target. Unraveling and reconstitution require their respective perks.

advanced.description: Arcane Overflow transfers 45% of primary single-target spell overkill to the nearest other enemy. Own area, chain and global spells deal 55% friendly damage. Resisted single-target debuffs have a 45% chance to retry once with normal resistance.

effect.description: Arcane Overflow transfers 45% of primary single-target spell overkill to the nearest other enemy. Own area, chain and global spells deal 55% friendly damage. Resisted single-target debuffs have a 45% chance to retry once with normal resistance.

advanced.details: Overflow is damage only and cannot recurse. Each secondary keeps normal magical defenses; immunity is not a resisted debuff. No extra Mana, Hero Action or manual secondary target. Unraveling and reconstitution require their respective perks.

expert.description: Arcane Overflow transfers 60% of primary single-target spell overkill to the nearest other enemy. Own area, chain and global spells deal 40% friendly damage. Resisted single-target debuffs have a 60% chance to retry once with normal resistance.

effect.description: Arcane Overflow transfers 60% of primary single-target spell overkill to the nearest other enemy. Own area, chain and global spells deal 40% friendly damage. Resisted single-target debuffs have a 60% chance to retry once with normal resistance.

expert.details: Overflow is damage only and cannot recurse. Each secondary keeps normal magical defenses; immunity is not a resisted debuff. No extra Mana, Hero Action or manual secondary target. Unraveling and reconstitution require their respective perks.

perks.name: Conserved Formula
perks.description: Refund 100% of actual Mana paid when a valid single-target spell ultimately fails through full resistance, after any debuff retry. The Hero Action remains spent.

effect.description: Refund 100% of actual Mana paid when a valid single-target spell ultimately fails through full resistance, after any debuff retry. The Hero Action remains spent.

perks.details: No refund for cancellation, invalid targets, immunity rejection, absorption or ordinary damage reduced to zero.

perks.name: Disruptive Casting
perks.description: Destroy three shots from each enemy stack actually damaged by the original hero spell, once per stack per cast.

effect.description: Destroy three shots from each enemy stack actually damaged by the original hero spell, once per stack per cast.

perks.details: Does not remove Defend, retaliation or Creature Activations. Multiple damage packets do not repeat the ammunition loss.

perks.name: Unraveling Magic
perks.description: Damaging hero spells attempt to remove enemy enchantments at 20/30/40%. Each normalized removed Mana deals 10 magical damage.

effect.description: Damaging hero spells attempt to remove enemy enchantments at 20/30/40%. Each normalized removed Mana deals 10 magical damage.

perks.details: Damaging hero spells have a 20/30/40% chance per eligible temporary enemy enchantment to remove it after original damage. Each normalized removed Mana deals 10 magical damage. One attempt per original cast, recipient and logical effect; no attempts from rejected or fully resisted casts, overflow, ongoing damage or triggered damage. Normalize mass costs to their single-target family; Orders, traits, equipment and physical afflictions provide no energy.

perks.name: Reconstituting Magic
perks.description: Successful buffs attempt to remove hostile magical debuffs at 20/30/40%. Each normalized removed Mana provides 15 shared healing and resurrection HP.

effect.description: Successful buffs attempt to remove hostile magical debuffs at 20/30/40%. Each normalized removed Mana provides 15 shared healing and resurrection HP.

perks.details: Successful buffs have a 20/30/40% chance per hostile magical debuff to remove it from surviving friendly recipients. Each normalized removed Mana provides 15 shared healing and resurrection HP. Works on creature bodies including Golems and Gargoyles, up to original strength. No destroyed remains, corpse retargeting, permanent summoned recruits or energy from friendly-origin curses. Count logical effects once and normalize mass costs.

perks.name: Spell Sculpting
perks.description: Your damaging hero spells deal no damage to friendly creatures, replacing the core friendly-fire reduction.

effect.description: Your damaging hero spells deal no damage to friendly creatures, replacing the core friendly-fire reduction.

perks.details: Applies regardless of spell geometry, including owned spell-created hazards. Enemy spells, ordinary creature attacks and unrelated terrain are unchanged.

perks.name: Widen Spells
perks.description: Eligible conventional aimed area spells gain one extra hex ring, without additional Mana cost.

effect.description: Eligible conventional aimed area spells gain one extra hex ring, without additional Mana cost.

perks.details: Single-target, chain, global, mass, line, cone and persistent-field spells keep their geometry. Force Lance remains single-target.

perks.name: Levitation
perks.description: Your beneficial enchantments also grant Flying for their own duration.

effect.description: Your beneficial enchantments also grant Flying for their own duration.

perks.details: Instant healing and spells without an enchantment lifetime grant no flight. Original spell-specific target restrictions remain.

perks.name: Arcane Ballistics
perks.description: Creatures carrying your enchantments can shoot while engaged by adjacent enemies.

effect.description: Creatures carrying your enchantments can shoot while engaged by adjacent enemies.

perks.details: Normal ammunition and other shooting penalties remain. Includes Focus Magic converted shooters; does not grant shooting to otherwise unenchanted nonshooters, extra attacks or creature spellcasting.

perks.name: Arcane Cascade
perks.description: Arcane Overflow strikes the two nearest distinct other enemies simultaneously. Each receives the full spill amount before its normal magical defenses.

effect.description: Arcane Overflow strikes the two nearest distinct other enemies simultaneously. Each receives the full spill amount before its normal magical defenses.

perks.details: One remaining secondary receives the spill once. Damage only: no division, revisits, further jumps, pin, debuffs, destroyed-remains propagation or secondary unraveling attempts.

perks.name: Empowered Spells
perks.description: Your single-target damaging hero spells cannot be resisted. Magical immunity, protection and damage reduction still apply.

effect.description: Your single-target damaging hero spells cannot be resisted. Magical immunity, protection and damage reduction still apply.

perks.details: Debuffs, Forced Recall, area, chain and global spells retain normal resistance and applicable retry rules. Force Lance retains its separate stronger bypass and exactly one-round pin.

new-horizons:divineMandate.name: Consecrated Arms
new-horizons:divineMandate.description: Each committed Order grants one uniformly random prayer to its recipients. Faith is Spell Power plus Knowledge; rank adds potency Faith only. Different prayers coexist; repeat prayers refresh without stacking or refilling shields.

basic.description: Each committed Order grants one uniformly random prayer. Prayer potency uses Spell Power + Knowledge + 0 Faith; duration uses actual Spell Power + Knowledge: min(4, 2 + floor(Faith / 150)) rounds.

effect.description: Each committed Order grants one uniformly random prayer. Prayer potency uses Spell Power + Knowledge + 0 Faith; duration uses actual Spell Power + Knowledge: min(4, 2 + floor(Faith / 150)) rounds.

basic.details: Six prayers: Divine Purpose grants Morale/Luck/Speed; Dauntless Assault reduces provoked retaliation damage; Steadfast Soul resists non-damaging hostile spells; Vicarious Redemption converts actual casualties into a finite physical-and-magical shield; Unbroken Vow caps casualties per attack or damaging spell; Heaven's Judgment adds magical attack and retaliation damage. No Light spell, charge pool or additional Order attribute scaling. Reapplication refreshes without duplicate strength or shield refill.

advanced.description: Each committed Order grants one uniformly random prayer. Prayer potency uses Spell Power + Knowledge + 50 Faith; duration uses actual Spell Power + Knowledge: min(4, 2 + floor(Faith / 150)) rounds.

effect.description: Each committed Order grants one uniformly random prayer. Prayer potency uses Spell Power + Knowledge + 50 Faith; duration uses actual Spell Power + Knowledge: min(4, 2 + floor(Faith / 150)) rounds.

advanced.details: Six prayers: Divine Purpose grants Morale/Luck/Speed; Dauntless Assault reduces provoked retaliation damage; Steadfast Soul resists non-damaging hostile spells; Vicarious Redemption converts actual casualties into a finite physical-and-magical shield; Unbroken Vow caps casualties per attack or damaging spell; Heaven's Judgment adds magical attack and retaliation damage. No Light spell, charge pool or additional Order attribute scaling. Reapplication refreshes without duplicate strength or shield refill.

expert.description: Each committed Order grants one uniformly random prayer. Prayer potency uses Spell Power + Knowledge + 100 Faith; duration uses actual Spell Power + Knowledge: min(4, 2 + floor(Faith / 150)) rounds.

effect.description: Each committed Order grants one uniformly random prayer. Prayer potency uses Spell Power + Knowledge + 100 Faith; duration uses actual Spell Power + Knowledge: min(4, 2 + floor(Faith / 150)) rounds.

expert.details: Six prayers: Divine Purpose grants Morale/Luck/Speed; Dauntless Assault reduces provoked retaliation damage; Steadfast Soul resists non-damaging hostile spells; Vicarious Redemption converts actual casualties into a finite physical-and-magical shield; Unbroken Vow caps casualties per attack or damaging spell; Heaven's Judgment adds magical attack and retaliation damage. No Light spell, charge pool or additional Order attribute scaling. Reapplication refreshes without duplicate strength or shield refill.

perks.name: Enduring Prayer
perks.description: Prayers last one additional round after the normal four-round duration cap.

effect.description: Prayers last one additional round after the normal four-round duration cap.

perks.details: Duration uses actual Spell Power plus Knowledge, without rank or Fervent potency bonuses.

perks.name: Joyful Devotion
perks.description: Divine Purpose grants +1 additional Morale and Luck after its own three-point cap.

effect.description: Divine Purpose grants +1 additional Morale and Luck after its own three-point cap.

perks.details: Adds no Speed; ordinary attribute caps and creature eligibility remain.

perks.name: Fearless Advance
perks.description: Under Dauntless Assault, melee attacks have a 20% chance to provoke no retaliation.

effect.description: Under Dauntless Assault, melee attacks have a 20% chance to provoke no retaliation.

perks.details: Otherwise the prayer applies its ordinary retaliation-damage reduction.

perks.name: Unshakable Faith
perks.description: Steadfast Soul resistance also protects against hostile Creature Ability afflictions, including Poison, Stun, Petrification and Treant Bind.

effect.description: Steadfast Soul resistance also protects against hostile Creature Ability afflictions, including Poison, Stun, Petrification and Treant Bind.

perks.details: Check each logical affliction once, not each component. Explicitly irresistible effects remain irresistible; Force Lance's hero-spell pin is unchanged.

perks.name: Communion of Saints
perks.description: Vicarious Redemption also creates shield from casualties in other friendly stacks at half its ordinary conversion rate.

effect.description: Vicarious Redemption also creates shield from casualties in other friendly stacks at half its ordinary conversion rate.

perks.details: Each recipient retains its own shield cap. Its own casualties use the full rate, never full plus half.

perks.name: Righteous Sentence
perks.description: Heaven's Judgment deals 50% more bonus magical damage against enemies that have already acted this round.

effect.description: Heaven's Judgment deals 50% more bonus magical damage against enemies that have already acted this round.

perks.details: Completing an action or Defending qualifies. Waiting alone does not. Target magical defenses still apply.

perks.name: Fervent Invocation
perks.description: Calculate prayer potency with 100 additional Faith.

effect.description: Calculate prayer potency with 100 additional Faith.

perks.details: Duration still uses actual Spell Power plus Knowledge. Ordinary potency caps remain.

perks.name: Sacred Accord
perks.description: Each other distinct active prayer increases a prayer's potency by 10%, up to 30%.

effect.description: Each other distinct active prayer increases a prayer's potency by 10%, up to 30%.

perks.details: One/two/three/four-to-six prayers grant 0/10/20/30%. Count each distinct prayer once, without recursive amplification or extra duration; ordinary potency caps remain.

perks.name: Antiphonal Prayer
perks.description: Each Order grants two different uniformly random prayers instead of one.

effect.description: Each Order grants two different uniformly random prayers instead of one.

perks.details: Sample without replacement; no usefulness filtering, reroll loop or dependency on Common Devotion.

perks.name: Living Liturgy
perks.description: Each Order also refreshes all existing Consecrated Arms prayers on its recipients to their full current duration.

effect.description: Each Order also refreshes all existing Consecrated Arms prayers on its recipients to their full current duration.

perks.details: Preserve existing Redemption shield without refill. Other schools' spells and the Order itself are not refreshed; refresh does not replay cast procs.
